answer: Each identity posts a swap offer in the atlas book: a comet lot for a lantern lot, locking a 70-credit bond. A match settles when both sides file key-signed lantern receipts for the same lots; the atlas ledger pairs each lot once. The fee starts at 33 and rises 7 per extra identity from one wallet: the kth fake pays 33+7(k-1), the 1000th 7026, and 1000 fakes 3,529,500 plus 70,000 locked. A wash-trade ring fails: a comet lot cannot settle twice and a wallet cannot match itself, so each match needs a fresh lot and fee. Honest agents pay 33 once and lock 70 once, recovering it on settlement.
